topic: What interference mitigation techniques are viable for overlapping service transmissions across geographically dispersed ground stations?
response: Rate Splitting Multiple Access (RSMA) and Cloud Radio Access Networks (C-RAN) can mitigate interference in overlapping service transmissions. RSMA separates users into multiple groups, allocating resources based on channel state information. C-RAN uses centralized processing to optimize resource allocation and interference mitigation. These techniques can be used in conjunction with Linear Equalizers (LE) and Kalman Filtering to reduce multipath and cochannel interference.
